items.title: Upnext
items.summary: Binge-watch your own shows from Google Drive in VLC, with the next episode always ready and English subtitles handled.
highlights: Prefetches the next episode while you watch and shows a countdown the second the end credits start, found with ffmpeg black frame detection
Finds English subtitles on OpenSubtitles, syncs them to the speech with ffsubsync, or generates them with Whisper on the Apple Silicon GPU, then embeds them in the file
Desktop app on FastAPI and pywebview that drives VLC through its web interface, so it works on macOS, Windows and Linux
